verdicts.reason: Both resizes are almost the same and share the same faults. The dark header band has become a large empty black block in the top-left, and the logo is shrunk to an illegible dot in its corner, so the brand mark is lost. The headline is crammed into a narrow right column, and the body copy, a tiny CTA, 'Ships late June' and the fine print are packed into the bottom with no breathing room. The CTA is no longer prominent and the divider is stranded. The only difference is that B's button text fills its pill edge to edge while A's keeps a little padding, which makes A marginally cleaner.
